newsitem.title: GERMANY: New German federal bond yields 5.80 pct at issue.
newsitem.headline: New German federal bond yields 5.80 pct at issue.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday the German government was issuing a new 10-year domestic bond with a 6.0 percent coupon.
The government issued 5.0 billion marks of the bond to the Federal Bond Consortium in a first tranche of the issue which is expected to total about 15 billion marks.
The tranche was sold at a fixed price of 101.45 for a yield of 5.80 percent.
A second tranche will be sold in an auction on Wednesday.
The Bundesbank said the new 10-year would come due on July 4, 2007 -- a maturity of 10 years and 69 days.
The first yield interest rate payment will be made on July 4, 1998 for 429 interest-earning days, it said.
The series number for the new bond is WKN 133 503.
